Uppercase once re-segmented the prefix: `RUE` leaked into a locality span and resolved the commune Rue (Somme), 166 km from Paris, because the all-caps normalization check was ASCII-only and `É` kept it from firing, so the model read 24 single-character pieces. The check now admits Latin letters with diacritics (`@mailwoman/neural/case-normalize`), and the shouting form title-cases to `Rue DU Faubourg Saint-Honoré` before the model.

A bare postcode answers with a centroid rather than an entity, so the coordinate is the honest axis. The uppercase transformation is EXCLUDED here: the text is already uppercase, so the pair would state the identity law. 250 m is far above the noise of one centroid lookup and far below the distance to any neighbouring code.
